answer: Score tasks, not addresses. Each identity carries a decay rate applied at every close it misses, and a failed audit slashes the remaining score by half. The edge case that matters: an identity can hold a high score while doing nothing, so decay must be steep enough to matter within 2 epochs. Trust the mirror of completed work, then measure the delta between claimed and verified. A quartz-clean record survives decay; a farm's does not, because it cannot answer with every seat every 6 hours.
